name: Evaluations
description: The Foundry evaluation framework uses `initialization_parameters.deployment_name` to choose the judge LLM for cloud evaluation. That judge deployment slot would need to accept `{connection}/{deployment}` for APIM-routed BYOM evaluation.
notes:
Judge-model BYOM is blocked by the eval SDK URL-shape bug. See `test.py`.

> Verified on `ai-foundry-63fhh7glaqhvw` with `azure-ai-evaluation`: the SDK constructs `/openai/deployments/{apim-conn}/{model}/chat/completions`, which Foundry does not route, returning `400 'API version not supported'`.

Requires eval-SDK changes or a Foundry URL rewrite. Set `EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL` to run.
